```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run private proof benchmark
        env:
          NODE_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/node_modules
        run: npx tsx scripts/benchmark-private-e2e.ts

      - name: Publish benchmark results to GitHub Pages
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Private Proof E2E Benchmark
          tool: custom
          output-file-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/latest.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          comment-always: false
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: 0.1
```
